key_provisions_or_claims: Approves EGF contribution of EUR 1,824,041 (60% of EUR 3,040,069) to Belgium
Covers 488 redundant workers and 300 NEETs in Hainaut
Calls for extending NEET access to EGF beyond 2017
Calls for revision of state aid and trade defence instruments
Requests public access to EGF case documents and impact data
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution of 23 June 2016 approving mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Belgium (Hainaut Machinery), supporting workers made redundant at Caterpillar Belgium, Carwall and Doosan, plus young NEETs. Unrelated to AI or robotics; concerns labour market adjustment funding.
